messages.subject: RE: Project Lyra — chain of title and FTO sign-off
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Confirmed. (1) The Leitner assignment was recorded at the EPO on 2 May 2019 and the USPTO on 11 June 2019 — both verified on the registers today. (2) Our FTO report (issued 8 Jan) concludes HRX-218 falls outside the EP'318 claims on a proper construction, and in any event EP'318 expires in 2027. The only live point is the third-party observation on the polymorph divisional, which does not touch the granted genus claims. Happy for you to cite us.

Alan

Sarah — Hartington has signed off on chain of title and FTO, so I've finalised the IP due-diligence report (dated 16 Jan). Risk ratings are all low/low-medium; the only items for the disclosure schedule are the Aldridge Seed charge (conditional release agreed), the EPO observation, and EP'318. Sending the report to Hartwell ahead of the board meeting.
